title: Silent self-DIO drop may mask bugs
description: File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py, Line 188-189. DIOs from self.node_address are silently dropped. While correct, this could mask bugs where a node receives its own reflected DIOs. Consider debug logging for this case in development builds.
close_reason: Added debug logging when self-DIOs are dropped to help diagnose reflected frame issues
